_comment: Thresholds and word lists for qc_check.py. client_names and active_client_palette are set per engagement; never commit real client names.
_totals_note: totals-sum fires only when components miss the stated total by more than 1 and by at most totals_window_pct of it (or 5 units); a wider miss means the Total is a different quantity, such as a crosstab total column.
_client_palettes_note: colours seen on shipped Huron/EDR paper (Sep 2026); fonts is the typeface allowlist for style-drift. Set active_client_palette per engagement.
_expand_note: Per engagement. A single capitalised token at the start of a paragraph (a chart label, a sentence opener) is never flagged. On the shipped federal deck the consultant kept HHS, DoD, VA, DHA and CMS as written and spelled out only DOE and, in one quote attribution, DHA; a default list of federal agencies produced 10 ignored warnings, so the default is short.
_italics_note: Italics and grey text outside footnotes are allowed as rare exceptions; above the threshold per deck they block. Rationale: title, body or footnote should carry everything a reader needs in a five-second scan; recurring small italic or grey detail text is the AI habit that works against it.
_tables_note: native-table-small warns on a native table within these bounds unless half or more of its cells are filled (a heatmap); the house builds small tables from text boxes and horizontal lines.
_words_note: Per body page: title + body + chart labels, footnotes counted separately, appendix pages exempt. Pages where half or more of the words sit inside quotation marks are exempt (quote pages). Set 2026-09-12 from the shipped minipack (typical 160-210) and public sector deck (typical 130-250); the one page above 300 drew the comment 'wordy'.
